summary: A per-check switch in the skip policy, "log": "shadow" (default) or "enforce": under enforce a pass skips only when the evidence log is present, signed, fresh, lists the chosen record and has lost none of the tree's records. A record the log lists that the remote lost is an ::error annotation on the gate's run in either mode.

replay.detail: No record or signature changes; every check stays in shadow until its policy entry says enforce.

schema.detail: The skip policy accepts an optional per-check key log (shadow or enforce); anything else is refused, as for every policy key.

rules.detail: Under log: enforce the verifier refuses a pass with log_absent, log_unsigned, log_stale, log_missing or log_unlogged, so the check runs; with no pinned log key nothing skips. Queue-entry rejection (require) is not held to the log.

compatibility.detail: The default is shadow, which is today's behavior.

downtime.detail: Nothing changes until a check is switched.

manual.detail: Each check is switched by its own policy change, on the measured trigger in the skip plan.

recovery.detail: Set the check's log back to shadow, or remove the key.
